camera_cases.reason: Uncompressed retention keeps all image-hypothesis combinations; no unauthorized pruning, mixture collapse, finite-particle replacement or MC was introduced. Long-run camera validation remains pending.

audit_scope: Independent audit of all 1,202 saved live ticks, actual received ROS records and archived source bytes. No new physical simulation, sensor generation or runtime mutation.
exact_checks: All 1,200 temporal branch transports, 1,202 raw-fusion/reexpression IDs, 49,282 endpoint Gaussian mean/covariance/within/between arrays, Dirac blocks and actual wire hashes matched bitwise.
numerical_checks: All 1,200 controller updates were checked against an independently reconstructed complete criterion. Representative complete-objective finite differences use an explicit floating-point subtraction/division roundoff bound.
source_correlation_scope: Each saved prior/fused state contains the full 66D covariance; temporal prediction records connect source and transported IDs, labels, versions, stamps, commands and linear/log weights. Raw frozen sensor posteriors and parent-to-child correspondence are retained.
limitations: The specified Bingham-derived high-concentration Gaussian proxies and reexpression approximations remain approximations; this audit does not establish exact global SO(3) distribution equivalence.

The continuous stiffness density retains its factors, with defined normalization integral and finite bounds. Its global normalization value and global moments were not computed; proposal points are not those moments or a discrete stiffness law.
Numeric stiffness-density evaluations may be unavailable at some equilibrium candidates; unavailable points were not converted to zero likelihood.
No long-run multi-branch camera acceptance is claimed. Separate analytic and short sequential tests cover evidence and retained image branches.
Both completed physical runs failed the 6mm reach condition; successful source identity is not physical task success.
